PDF Sparse Volume Rendering using Hardware Ray Tracing and Block Walking
Although the ray tracing hardware in modern GPUs are designed to accelerate ray-triangle intersection acceleration, there already are some works using the hardware to render structured volume data and unstructured volume data [Ganter and Manzke 2019] [Wald et al. 2021]. The focus of our paper is the visualization of the structured volume data, and thus, [Ganter and Manzke 2019] is relevant for ...
